newsitem.title: FRANCE: AMR to order from Brazil's Embraer - sources.
newsitem.headline: AMR to order from Brazil's Embraer - sources.

text.p: Brazilian aircraft manufacturer Embraer said that it would be announcing a new airline order "by a major airline" at the Paris air show on Wednesday, at 0800 GMT.
No other details were immediately available, but industry sources confirmed the order was from U.S. airline giant AMR Corp's domestic carrier American Eagle.
The order is expect to be for Embraers 50-seat EMB-145 regional passenger jet.
No details of aircraft type or number were immediately available but American said on Tuesday it was planning a press briefing later today at Fort Worth, Texas, on plans for its regional jet fleet.
Industry analysts have said American is expected to order up to 67 regional passenger jets in a $1.2 billion deal from either Embraer or Bombardier Inc.
